supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity is accounted for by C:\Program Files\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe connecting through the proxy to update.chartmate-imaging.com. The observed connections recur at roughly five-minute intervals, consistent with the approved ChartMate update behavior in the supplied inventory context.

The domain account lucy.park obtained Kerberos tickets from WS-BCARTER-01 for service WS-LPARK-01$, followed by a network logon for lucy.park on WS-LPARK-01 from WS-BCARTER-01. This is an unexpected cross-workstation authentication in the supplied context, which says remote administration is only performed from WS-OHADDAD-01.

A UserAssist registry event attributed to ben.carter contains a ROT13-encoded path that decodes to C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe. This is evidence of a PowerShell usage artifact, but not direct proof of a process launch or of what it did.

ben.carter launched Cisco AnyConnect's vpnui.exe, and the process loaded a validly signed Cisco vpnapi.dll. The supplied environment context says there is no VPN; these records show a client launch, not an established VPN connection.
WS-BCARTER-01 connected to DC-HD-01 over SMB, and DC-HD-01 recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon. The records do not identify the share or establish what, if anything, was accessed.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied evidence has a PowerShell-related UserAssist artifact but no corresponding powershell.exe process-creation record or command-line evidence; the artifact alone does not establish the commands or actions performed. (T026-00137)
The AnyConnect evidence shows vpnui.exe execution and a signed module load, but no VPN tunnel establishment or VPN network traffic. (T026-00221, T026-00223)
The SMB records show a connection and ANONYMOUS LOGON but do not include share, file-operation, or transfer details. (T026-00158, T026-00161, T026-00162)

The periodic ChartMate connections are visible through the proxy and endpoint network telemetry, but the supplied records do not include the updater's signature, hash, or destination-side validation. (T026-00095, T026-00098)
claims_not_established: Whether the lucy.park authentication from WS-BCARTER-01 was authorized or resulted from credential compromise.
Whether PowerShell actually executed in this interval, and, if so, what commands or scripts it ran.
Whether AnyConnect established a VPN connection.
Whether the anonymous SMB session accessed any share or data.
Whether the observed activity was performed by ben.carter or by another person using that workstation or account.
additional_evidence_needed: Correlate the lucy.park logon with WS-LPARK-01 endpoint logs, account/session records, and any approved help-desk activity.
Collect endpoint process and PowerShell operational/script-block logs for WS-BCARTER-01 around the review window, including parent/child process details and command lines.
Review AnyConnect client and network gateway logs to determine whether a tunnel was attempted or established.
Collect DC-HD-01 SMB audit/share-access records for the anonymous session.
Validate the ChartMate updater's file hash, signature, and expected configuration.
